evidence.notes: StandardController lifecycle over seeded SObject records.
StandardSetController getRecord/getId/setPageSize over seeded SObject records.

source.content: @isTest private class UIApexPagesStandardControllerLifecycleTest { @isTest static void standardControllerLifecycle() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'Test Account'); insert account; ApexPages.StandardController sc = new ApexPages.StandardController(account); SObject retrieved = sc.getRecord(); System.assertEquals(account.Name, ((Account)retrieved).Name); System.assertEquals(account.Id, sc.getId()); sc.addFields(new List<String>{'Description'}); } @isTest static void standardSetControllerLifecycle() { Account a1 = new Account(Name = 'A1'); Account a2 = new Account(Name = 'A2'); insert new List<Account>{a1, a2}; List<Account> accounts = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE 'A%' ORDER BY Name]; ApexPages.StandardSetController ssc = new ApexPages.StandardSetController(accounts); System.assertEquals(2, ssc.getResultSize()); System.assertEquals(2, ssc.getRecords().size()); ssc.setPageSize(1); System.assertEquals(1, ssc.getPageSize()); } }
